title: Only 7% Pass This Intelligence Test
summary: Explore Quick Think, Pattern Decoder, Logic Under Pressure, Reasoning Trapdoors, The Intelligence Vault across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Read the clues. Make the connections.
Put your thinking to the test.

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: Quick Think, Pattern Decoder, Logic Under Pressure, Reasoning Trapdoors, The Intelligence Vault. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a standardised intelligence, IQ, aptitude, educational or psychological assessment.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.
